entities.name: Great Wall of China (Early)
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Qin Shi Huang connected earlier walls into a continuous northern barrier. Rammed earth and stone. Extended and rebuilt over 2,000 years; most visible sections are Ming Dynasty (1368–1644).
